verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (polynomial zonotope / reachability arithmetic, ARMOUR/ARMTD project)
verdict.provenance_detail: Hand-written research code for ARMOUR/ARMTD robot arm safety verification, computing joint reachable sets (JRS) online using polynomial zonotope arithmetic
verdict.purpose: Computes joint reachable sets (JRS) online for a robot arm using polynomial zonotope arithmetic, supporting two trajectory parameterizations (original ARMTD parabolic and Bernstein polynomial), with tracking error bounds and rotation matrix reachable sets for use in safety-constrained motion planning.
